text: Final categorization: OK (Justification: This is a non-review research paper focusing explicitly on national-scale spatial implementation of future land use and land cover (LULC) changes in Lithuania. The model calibration and validation are quantitatively assessed (80% accuracy), and habitat quality impacts are evaluated spatially.
